name: Two-M1 current RC original electrical matrix

  contents: read
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: cdr-drain-m1-loaded-source-${{ github.ref }}

          python -B - <<'PY'
          import hashlib,json,os,re,subprocess,sys

          assert e['GITHUB_REF']=='refs/heads/codex/cdr-drain-m1-loaded-electrical'
          assert e['REQUESTED_MODE']in ('controls','preparation','loaded') and sys.version_info[:2]==(3,12)
          assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',e['GITHUB_SHA']) and re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*',e['GITHUB_RUN_ID'])
          assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==e['GITHUB_SHA']
          p=Path('scripts/cdr-drain-m1-loaded-methods.json')
          assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()
          raw=p.read_bytes();m=json.loads(raw)
          assert m['schema']=='cdr-drain-m1-loaded-execution-v1' and m['branch']=='codex/cdr-drain-m1-loaded-electrical'
          assert m['source_controls_authorized'] is True
          for name in ('geometry_generation_authorized','native_extraction_authorized','accepted','electrical_accepted','physical_accepted','cdr_accepted','qualified_pex','full_phy_accepted','automatic_retry'):
              assert m[name] is False,name
          for name in ('workflow_dispatch_authorized','preparation_authorized','native_execution_authorized','simulation_authorized','controller_readiness'):
              assert type(m[name])is bool,name
          assert m['native_execution_authorized']is m['simulation_authorized']
          assert m['controller_readiness']is(m['preparation_authorized']or m['simulation_authorized'])
          assert not m['simulation_authorized']or m['preparation_authorized']
          if e['REQUESTED_MODE']!='controls':
              assert m['workflow_dispatch_authorized']is True and m['controller_readiness']is True
              assert m['preparation_authorized'if e['REQUESTED_MODE']=='preparation'else'simulation_authorized']is True
          assert len(m['protected_sha256'])>=1744

          out=Path('hw/soc/out/cdr-drain-m1-loaded-controls');out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
